items.name: The instrument maintainer moves a golden for a recorded reason
items.rule: A golden moves only with one recorded reason, and the scenario it was written from
items.evidence: Written g-40/s-12; move to g-41 instrument-behavior-changed with note returned instrument-golden-moved with exactly golden-id, from-digest g-40, to-digest g-41, reason, additions-only, note, scenario-digest s-12, moved-at; goldens show digest g-41, scenario-digest s-12, one move with that reason and note; a second move appended in order.

items.name: "Spec grew" over a diff that is not additions only is refused
items.rule: A golden moves only with one recorded reason, and the scenario it was written from
items.evidence: G-checklist g-50; move to g-51 spec-grew with additions-only false -> -32000 spec-grew-not-additions-only; goldens still g-50, moves []; store gained no moved event. Control: additions-only true then moves to g-51.

items.name: A move without a note is refused
items.rule: A golden moves only with one recorded reason, and the scenario it was written from
items.evidence: Move g-40 -> g-41 instrument-behavior-changed with note "" -> -32000 data.refusal empty-note (not -32602); goldens still g-40, moves [].

items.name: A golden is never moved for a reason outside the three
items.rule: A golden moves only with one recorded reason, and the scenario it was written from
items.evidence: reason 'make the self-check green' and 'make-the-self-check-green' -> -32602 Invalid params (schema enum, decisions Slice 03 4); goldens still g-40, moves []; no moved event in store.

items.name: A golden whose scenario digest is not its scenario's is refused
items.rule: An instrument golden is written from its scenario and carries that scenario's digest
items.evidence: Digests file {scenario: s-12}; write G-score-unknown with s-11 -> -32000 scenario-digest-mismatch; goldens []; store holds no golden event.

items.name: A move to the same digest is refused
items.rule: A golden moves only with one recorded reason, and the scenario it was written from
items.evidence: Move g-40 -> g-40 wording-replaced note 'no change' -> -32000 same-digest; goldens show g-40 with moves [].

items.name: A move that names a stale scenario digest is refused
items.rule: A golden moves only with one recorded reason, and the scenario it was written from
items.evidence: Written g-40 with s-12; digests file changed to s-13 while the candidate ran; move g-41 wording-replaced with s-12 -> -32000 stale-scenario-digest; goldens still g-40, scenario-digest s-12, moves [].

items.name: The instrument maintainer writes a golden from its scenario
items.rule: An instrument golden is written from its scenario and carries that scenario's digest
items.evidence: Write G-score-unknown s-12 g-40 -> instrument-golden-written with exactly golden-id, scenario, scenario-digest s-12, path, digest g-40, written-at (ISO UTC); goldens show digest g-40, scenario-digest s-12, moves [].

items.name: A golden is written once
items.rule: An instrument golden is written from its scenario and carries that scenario's digest
items.evidence: Second write of G-score-unknown with g-41 -> -32000 golden-exists; goldens list exactly one G-score-unknown at g-40.

items.name: Moving a golden that was never written is refused
items.rule: A golden moves only with one recorded reason, and the scenario it was written from
items.evidence: Fresh store; move G-unknown to g-41 spec-grew (note 'grew', additions-only true) -> -32000 no-such-golden; goldens [].

items.name: Rewording a scenario changes its scenario digest and keeps its item identity
items.rule: A golden moves only with one recorded reason, and the scenario it was written from
items.evidence: Written from '@item-03-004' with s-12, g-40; digests file reworded to s-13 live (no restart); move g-41 wording-replaced note 'reworded' with s-13 succeeds (event scenario-digest s-13); goldens show g-41, scenario-digest s-13.
